properties.description:
Cut 2026-09-13. Four PRs since v0.59.0 (#495, #496, #497, #498).

The increment closes all six items a consumer project (flo2) sent across. One was closed by refuting its own premise — the memory it asked us to tune was the export path, not RocksDB. Two were unblocked by finishing `cap:select-graph-by-id`, whose resolution half had shipped in August with no caller outside its own tests. One paid a debt that had stood open two and a half weeks because nothing in flo2 can write to this graph.

THE SCHEMA STAMP DOES NOT MOVE — 28 node types, 65 edge types, schema 1, verified field by field against v0.59.0's export — so no upgrade document is owed and a consumer updates without touching their design.
properties.name: v0.60.0 — a consumer's handoff answered end to end
